turns.speaker: rider
turns.text: Haan bhaiya, main ek bade grey gate ke paas hoon. Par gate toh band hai.

turns.speaker: locus
turns.text: Koi baat nahi. Wahan se koi dukaan ya board dikh raha hai?

turns.speaker: rider
turns.text: Haan, saamne ek doodh ki dukaan hai.

turns.speaker: locus
turns.text: Badhiya. Doodh ki dukaan se aage medical store tak aaiye. Uske bagal wali gali mein neela gate hai.

turns.speaker: rider
turns.text: Achha... haan, neela gate dikh gaya. Pahunch gaya.
